title: Noncommutative $L_p$-differentiability and trace formulae
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a semifinite von Neumann algebra equipped with a normal faithful semifinite trace $τ$, and let $L_p(\mathcal{M})$ denote the associated noncommutative $L_p$-space for $1<p<\infty$. Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $a, b$ be $τ$-measurable self-adjoint operators such that $b\in L_p(\mathcal{M})\cap L_{np}(\mathcal{M})$. For a function $f\in C^n(\mathbb{R})$ whose derivatives $f^{(k)}$ are bounded for $1\le k\le n$, we prove that the map $φ:t\in\mathbb{R}\mapsto f(a+tb)-f(a)$ is $n$-times differentiable in the $\|\cdot\|_{L_p}$-norm.
